points.text: Hub ships one baked atlas, res://assets/baked/hub_light.png from LightRt.save_hub_bake, at HUB_SUB 16 (at least 1088x1024). Stamp.paint stays dungeon-only.
scenes/camp.tscn does not embed the atlas and does not ship packed Generated.
Yard atlas paints a warm sun disc and a small crystal bump on cream Color(0.98, 0.96, 0.93). Interiors are not written. Dirt owns the yard.
Shadows project the live hall, wing, stall, and awning boxes along the actor sun, -X +Z, feathered. No skirt smear and no shed AABB. shadow_px not 0 is a pipeline check, not the look pass.

Hall and wing are gables as tall as the face art. Both awnings hang off the south eave and cover the painted shingle band. Roofs stop at the wall edge. Lids sample the atlas; russet matches the awning, not the sun disc.
Stall tarp is one pitched plaza_tarp sheet over the counter. Collision is the live wall, gable, awning, and stall-pitch meshes.

Play zoom 0.69 judges roofs and puddles. The 0.38 frame is the wide shot only. The recipe stitches play, hall eave, stall front, and stall side, and capture reapplies the pose. apply_zoom returns while warm_hold.
Floors default to 128 rooms. Links are L-doglegs on the 1 m grid, not band stamps.
Extra loops carve only a clear L. Hug gap defaults to 4 unused cells, minimum 3. Stubs stay a small leaf budget. Fillet and jag stay unused.
Outline spans come from room and hall shapes. Hall fragments skip room rims. Piece bake is 0.25 m. Occupancy-march walls are not the wall.
Stream builds live chunks from published runs. Collision is the run-bounded solid, not a 1 m slab. Neighbors stream one chunk per follow. Geometry jobs sleep to pending.
Enter light is plan then stamp before the fade. First stamp is RING_IN. RING_OUT waits until the fade ends.
Cover drops after the 16 ms pump (two frames, cap 12), not after two follow frames. Extra crystals stay on the spawn place so seed-42 letters hold.
Web shots copy the PNG on an STA thread as image, bytes, and a file drop, after the Godot PID is gone, and check the clipboard holds an image.
file_stat.py owns length, newline, BOM, and indent probes. The week packet writes Desktop/copy.txt without turn dumps.
Headless bot smokes may use the Godot 4.7.2 Linux pin. Editor playtest and the Steam Windows binary stay forbidden.

points.text: Opened development week 5 on the live path
Placeholdia yard uses seamless grass and packed-dirt sheets; the path stays cobble-tinted; a post-and-rail fence rings the slab
Guild and reception sit as 3D boxes with russet shingles and a short striped awning; the vendor stall keeps its canvas tarp
Dummy pad, floor crystal, anvil, and notice board keep labeled spots; camp layout is one authored yard

Actors pick up light at their feet. Hub squash is one sun mark for the whole yard. Dungeon squash is up to three nearby torches, crystals, or fires, pinned to the current walk frame, faded so marks do not smear
Dungeon walls are brick ribbons along the floor outline, with caps on tops and ends, not one box per cell
Floors follow a carved outline: filleted corners, occasional jagged runs, then filled solid. Hall joins keep a closed rim so walkable holes do not open at diagonal bands
Collision follows that same solid. Ribbons are a thin shell on the outline; you walk the fill, not the brick
Torches hang on wall brackets and throw a real light disc; crystals and campfires do the same. Occupancy keeps stamps off solid rock
Ground in the dungeon uses the dungeon-floor sheet; light and shadow paint across the walkable fill
Interact props register as light sources so benches and pads take the same discs
Entering a floor still covers immediately; nearby volume streams first. The dungeon scene is packed before the swap
Returning to the hub no longer freezes the session
The HUD map well is built when the floor is ready. Opening the map only toggles the overlay; it does not create the picture
Title load uses the new load background and a dark plate over the art
Ground scale, wear, outline fillet/jag, and torch / crystal / fire / sun range and energy are on the secret debug menu
